description: A conspicuous, rectilinear, north–south–trending raised ridge or embankment approximately 350–400 m in length, 15–20 m in width and rising ~0.3–0.6 m above the surrounding low‐relief terrain. The feature shows a subtle paired linear depression immediately to its east, suggesting it may have functioned as a canal–embankment system for water management. It is extremely subtle in the visual Sentinel-2 data but is high-contrast in the LiDAR‐derived hillshade and correlates with a narrow band of slightly reduced NIR reflectance (possible soil moisture retention or dark‐earth signature).
